newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold closes easier but off day's low in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Gold closes easier but off day's low in Hong Kong.

text.p: Gold closed easier on Friday but off the day's low on late selling, following a lower close in New York overnight, dealers said.
Bullion hit a low of US$379.50/380.00 an ounce before closing at US$379.60/380.10, down from New York's US$380.40/90 close on Thursday.
"Gold fell in the afternoon in response to the U.S. dollar rising to above 112.50 against the yen and continued weaker silver prices," said a dealer at a local investment house.
"The sentiment was still on the cautious side of bearish," a dealer said. "Gold is likely to test downside at US$378 levels again."
Local gold fell HK$9 to close at HK$3,499 a tael.
The carryover charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped from -5 to -5.40 on Friday.
The local market will be closed on Monday for the local Chung Yeung festival.
